explication: Cultivation World Simulator is an AI-driven cultivation-world simulation in which the player observes the world as its “Heavenly Dao” and can intervene. The main loop runs from the web UI or external client through read-only queries and controlled commands, then back to refreshed world state and events. The backend also advances autonomous avatar, sect, and world simulation; roleplay choices can involve the player, while LLM services drive AI behavior. The README documents these capabilities; links for unsampled subsystems are limited to documented flows and the visible module structure.
